journal: I found the ghostly woman, but as I drew near to her, she approached a nearby sewer entrance and vanished before my eyes. I should follow her and see where the sewer entrance leads.

Having followed the apparition, I have found myself inside an abandoned vault. A mysterious sword floats suspended in a magical field at the heart of the vault. Judging by the condition of this place, it looks as if it has lain undisturbed for a very long time. Perhaps if I proceed forward, I may find some answers and a way to unlock the sword.

I have battled a strange warrior in the depths of this vault, but he vanished before I could strike my killing blow. However, when he vanished, there was a great burst of magic energy and the ground shook beneath me. I should head back to the sword chamber where perhaps I may encounter him again.

Upon returning to the sword chamber, I found the shield surrounding the sword had altered its magical appearance and its hold upon the blade. Could it be that the shield is influenced by defeating the Guardian? As another chamber door has opened, I should proceed into this new area and see if this theory holds any truth.

I have encountered the Guardian once more, only this time he was empowered with dark magic. Once again, upon nearing defeat, he vanished and the vault reacted to this magic. I should return to the sword chamber to see if more of this vault has now become accessible.
Once again, my encounter with the Guardian has affected the shield that surrounds the sword. I should search the newly opened area where I may encounter the Guardian once more.
I have vanquished the Guardian. I should return to the sword chamber to see if his defeat has affected the shield.

Upon returning to the sword chamber, I witnessed what appeared to be a reconciliation between the Guardian and the woman, for I saw their spirits embrace and fade away. Perhaps in defeating him, I have actually freed his spirit from his binds to the sword and this vault. Now he is free and so too is the sword.

journal: Arniel Gane has asked for help with a special project he's working on. Although he won't tell me what they're for, he wants me to bring him a number of Dwarven Cogs.

Arniel has asked for more help with his project, though this time the request is very different. Enthir is apparently refusing to follow through on a trade; something Arniel needs for his work. He's asked that I go speak with Enthir on his behalf.

Arniel has finally revealed to me that his secret project deals with the disappearance of the dwarves, though he hasn't been clear about how his work relates to it. He's given me a warped soul gem, and asked me to find several Dwarven Convectors in the various ruins around Skyrim. I'm supposed to place the gem inside a convector, and then heat it using a spell Arniel has taught me. When I've done this several times, I should return the gem to Arniel.
Arniel has once again asked me to speak to Enthir, who was supposed to deliver something else relating to Arniel's project.

journal: Arniel asked me to deal with Enthir, who was supposedly refusing to complete a business arrangement. Enthir insists that he hasn't been paid, but will consider the deal done if I acquire a staff for him from [Dungeon].

Arniel was convinced that Enthir was refusing to complete the trade the two of them had arranged, but it turns out that this time Enthir never received the item in question. The courier bringing the item never arrived. If I want to help Arniel finish his work, I'll need to find the courier myself.

Arniel was distraught over being unable to finish his project, believing that Enthir was refusing to complete a trade the two of them had agreed upon. Instead, the courier that was supposed to deliver the item never arrived. I've tracked him down (sadly he did not survive) and have the package Arniel wanted. I should make sure it gets to Arniel as soon as possible.

I've managed to complete the trade agreement between Enthir and Arniel, and have the object Arniel was interested in. It's some sort of soul gem, though Enthir believes it to be useless. I should deliver it to Arniel.

I've successfully altered Arniel's warped soul gem, and should return it to him. It is somehow critical to his project regarding the disappearance of the dwarves; perhaps he'll explain exactly what he's up to.

I've helped Arniel with the final piece of his project, by tracking down a missing courier who was supposed to be delivering an item from Morrowind. That item is Keening, a dwarven dagger that Arniel claims is very important. With it, he says he's able to finish his experiment and has asked that I observe what happens.

journal: Swims-In-Deep-Water has given me a list of fish I should catch to improve my fishing skills. I should read the note to see what I need to catch.

Swims-In-Deep-Water would like me to catch fish that can commonly be caught in streams and lakes in the warmer parts of Skyrim. Once I've caught one of each, I should return them to him. His field guide, Fishing Mastery, should provide details on each fish and how they can be caught. He mentioned that a copy is sitting on a shelf in the back room of the Riften Fishery.

I read the first volume of Fishing Mastery, Swims-In-Deep-Water's field guide. All of the fish I need to catch can be caught in the warmer parts of Skyrim on a clear day. Goldfish and glassfish can only be caught in lakes, while pogfish are found in streams. Carp can be caught in both lakes and streams. I should be able to catch what I need by fishing of off the docks near the Riften Fishery, and along the river that leads to Ivarstead.
I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge. In return, he gave me a sum of gold, as well as a key to the Riften Fishery.

The plan worked perfectly and Whiterun's Captain of the Guard was stricken with illness when he drank the poisoned mead. Sabjorn's been carted off to jail and Honningbrew Meadery is now closed.
Now that Mallus's position as the owner of Honningbrew Meadery has been secured, I need to find any information explaining how Sabjorn was able to fund this costly operation.

The information I obtained from Honningbrew Meadery points to the same anonymous buyer of Goldenglow Estate. If successful, this individual would have completely estranged Maven Black-Briar from the Guild and destroyed it economically. It's becoming painfully obvious that it's time to shed some light on our mysterious adversary before they have a chance to strike again.

For my final challenge, the fish I am to catch are both rare and found in locations all over Skyrim. Angelfish can be found in temperate lakes, and can only be caught with an Alik'r fishing rod. The lyretail anthias can be caught in temperate streams with the Alik'r rod as well. Anglers are only caught in freezing waters using the Argonian fishing rod. journal: I've discovered a strange Dwemer ruin, where a mercenary party has been attacked by hostile machines. I should investigate.
It seems a mage had set up camp in the heart of the ruins. Unfortunately, he was struck by lightning before I could reach him. Maybe I can find out more about these ruins by inspecting his remains.

According to the mage's journal, Vardnknd contains a device capable of controlling the weather. However, without a steward to manage it, the storm has increased in size and threatens to affect weather outside of the ruins. Left unchecked, it could spread to the rest of Skyrim. It seems the only way to shut down the system is to disable four separate conduits in sub-facilities throughout the ruins.
With all the conduits deactivated, I should be able to proceed and shut down the source of this inclement weather.
I defeated the Sky Orchestrator. The violent weather seems to have ceased as a result.
At the center of the ruin I have encountered an enormous Dwarven machine. As the weather seems to obey it, perhaps destroying it will stop the storm.

journal: Karliah believes the only proof that could expose Mercer's treachery can be found within the pages of Gallus's journal which she recovered from Snow Veil Sanctum. Unfortunately, the journal is written in some sort of code that needs to be deciphered. Our only hope is Enthir, one of Karliah and Gallus's former acquaintances who is a wizard at the College of Winterhold.

Enthir has informed me that Gallus's Journal is written in Falmer. He's directed me to seek out Calcelmo, the Court Wizard in Markarth who is the foremost authority on them in hopes of obtaining a translation.

journal: After Enthir successfully translated Gallus's journal, I've discovered that Mercer's motivations transcended simple greed or murder. According to Gallus, he defiled the temple and betrayed the Thieves Guild. Karliah insists we bring this information to Brynjolf immediately.

Olfrid Battle-Born has a good friend residing in Whiterun's jail who is slated for execution. In order to free him, a prisoner registry in the steward of Whiterun's quarters must be changed and a letter stolen from the Jarl's quarters in Dragonsreach.
Arn is now a free man and the Thieves Guild can now count on Olfrid Battle-Born as an influential ally in Whiterun.

description: Collect the ten missing pages of Saint Jiub's Opus.
reward: Locket of Saint Jiub, Saint Jiub's Opus

journal: While exploring the Soul Cairn, I've come across the soul of a strange Dunmer named Jiub. He claims to be writing the second volume of his life's story but lacks the notes from his first in order to complete it. He's asked for my help in locating the pages which are likely spread across the entire Soul Cairn... quite a daunting task.
objectives: Find pages from Saint Jiub's Opus ([Global=DLC1VQSaintCount]/10)

journal: I've located all of the notes that Jiub lost when he arrived in the Soul Cairn. I should return them to him when I get the chance.
I've returned all of Jiub's lost notes to the poor soul. He presented me with an an amulet and a pristine copy of his first volume in appreciation for my efforts.

name: In A Pinch
description: Obtain a juvenile mudcrab for research.

journal: I met Viriya, one of the employees at the Riften Fishery. She handed me a bounty letter and seemed rather frustrated. I should see what it has to say.

Viriya at the Riften Fishery has been conducting research on breeding mudcrabs to harvest their meat, much like fish. She has issued a bounty for someone to obtain a juvenile mudcrab for her studies, but the last person to accept the bounty never returned. I should speak to her when I am ready to take over the bounty.
objectives: Speak to Viriya about taking over the bounty

journal: Viriya at the Riften Fishery has been conducting research on mudcrabs in the hopes that they could be more easily bred and harvested, much like fish. She has issued a bounty for someone to obtain a juvenile mudcrab for her studies, but the last person to accept the bounty never returned. I should try fishing one up myself in the streams and lakes in the temperate parts of Skyrim. One lake in particular is known to be teeming with mudcrab, which Viriya mentioned was west of Broken Fang Cave.
objectives: Obtain a juvenile mudcrab for Viriya

journal: I turned a juvenile mudcrab over to Viriya for her research. In return, she gave me a key to the Riften Fishery so that I may enter whenever I need to.

journal: The barmaid at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun is apparently a fugitive noble from Hammerfell. She claims that she is on the run from assassins sent by rival houses in her homeland and needs someone to stop them before they find her.

Find a way to enter the Alik'r hideout
Kill Kematu or talk to him
Kill Kematu OR Convince Saadia to meet Kematu

I've helped Saadia escape the clutches of the Alik'r sent after her. With their leader defeated, she believes the rest of them will scatter, affording her some much-needed safety for now.
After making arrangements with Kematu, I've delivered Saadia to him. He assures me that she will be taken back to Hammerfell alive, though after that her fate is no longer in his hands.
|Unknown||

reward: Bow of Shadows and Leveled Gold

journal: With the death of King Torygg, it seems not even the Jarls are safe in Skyrim, and security comes at a premium. Given the need for capable warriors, I should speak with the steward and see if he has any work for me.
In Whiterun, I spoke to the Jarl's steward and asked him if he had any work. He handed me a note with details on a job.

In Whiterun, I spoke to the Jarl's steward and asked him if he had any work. He handed me a note with details on a job. Reading the note, it seems there may be a potential assassination plot against the Jarl. The steward wants me to visit the local alchemist and check if anyone has purchased any poisons.
objectives: Take the ledger copy at Arcadia's Cauldron

journal: It seems there may be a potential assassination plot against the Jarl. At the steward's direction, I visited a local alchemist and took a copy of her ledger. I should read it to see if anyone has recently purchased any poisons.

It seems there may be a potential assassination plot against the Jarl. At the steward's direction, I visited a local alchemist and took a copy of her ledger. I read it and found two people had purchased poisons. A priest at the Hall of the Dead, and a stable boy.
objectives: Investigate the Hall of the Dead

journal: At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. He intends to take the shot from somewhere unoccupied, using the Bow of Shadows to conceal himself. It's likely he will only appear when the Jarl is not tending to any other business. I should find him and take him out before he can carry through with the plot.
objectives: Find the Assassin on the upper floor of Dragonsreach when the Jarl is unoccupied

journal: [!--There's a mistake.--]
At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. After following his trail, I found him in Dragonsreach and eliminated him.

At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. After following his trail, I found him in Dragonsreach and eliminated him, taking the Bow of Shadows for myself.

At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. After following his trail, I found him in Dragonsreach and eliminated him, taking the Bow of Shadows for myself. I then returned to the steward and received my reward.

journal: I heard a rumor that a boy named Aventus Aretino, in Windhelm, has been attempting to contact the Dark Brotherhood. I should find this boy and speak with him, and find out why he wants to contact a guild of assassins.

The mother of Aventus Aretino recently died, and the boy was sent to live at Honorhall Orphanage in Riften. He thinks I'm a Dark Brotherhood assassin, and wants me to kill the Orphanage's sadistic headmistress, Grelod the Kind.

objectives: Tell Aventus Aretino that Grelod is dead

journal: |!|Innocence Lost|DB01
I killed Grelod the Kind, and Aventus Aretino rewarded me with a family heirloom. Now the boy can return to Honorhall Orphanage, and live out his childhood peacefully.

name: Interception
giver: Talking to Azadi in Shor's Stone
description: Aid the Hammerfell resistance.

journal: A fighter in Shor's Stone has been rumored to have been causing trouble by trying to start fights with anyone who passes by. I should see if there's a way to get him to stop being such a nuisance.
objectives: Speak to the fighter in Shor's Stone

journal: I accepted Azadi's challenge in Shor's Stone, and must now defeat him in an unarmed brawl. Perhaps if I beat some sense into him, he will go someplace else.
objectives: Defeat Azadi in an unarmed brawl

journal: I convinced Azadi to stop bothering the residents of Shor's Stone without a fight. He handed me a note, and then vanished into thin air. I should read what the note has to say.
I defeated Azadi in an unarmed brawl. After the fight, he handed me a note, and then vanished into thin air. I should read what the note has to say.
Azadi's note was mysterious, only saying that "they" would somehow contact me. I should expect to receive a letter from a courier soon.
objectives: Wait to be contacted by courier

journal: I received a letter from someone named Fijeh by courier. I should read what it has to say.

I received a letter from Fijeh, who seemed to know about my encounter with Azadi. Fijeh and Azadi are members of a secretive group of spies and warriors from Hammerfell called the Remnants. Fijeh is trying to rescue a fellow Remnant that was captured by the Thalmor, aided by a Thalmor sympathizer. Fijeh would like my assistance in helping track down his brother in arms. He asked to meet in Purewater Run, in the hills near Markarth.
I met Fijeh in Purewater Run. He handed me a set of instructions detailing the next step of the mission to rescue Rakeed.

Fijeh has requested that I gather intelligence about the whereabouts of the captured Remnant from two spies, in Karthwasten and Ivarstead, by speaking a special phrase to them: "The ravens take flight once more."
objectives: Find the Remnant spy behind the Miner's Barracks in Karthwasten
Find the Remnant spy in front of Vilemyr Inn in Ivarstead

journal: I spoke the secret phrase to Josla, a Remnant spy in Karthwasten. She handed me a note that should contain information about the whereabouts of the captured Remnant.

After speaking to a Remnant spy, I learned that Rakeed will be transported through Skyrim very soon under heavy Thalmor guard by caravan, along with the Hammerfell noble that aided in his capture. Their destination is the city of Blacklight in Morrowind. I should seek out the spy in Ivarstead to learn more.
I spoke the secret phrase to Sirayar, a Remnant spy in Ivarstead. He handed me a note that should contain information about the whereabouts of the captured Remnant.

After speaking to a Remnant spy, I learned that Rakeed will be transported to Morrowind through Skyrim by crossing the border to the southwest from Hammerfell, and should be traveling the road near Sunderstone Gorge. I should seek out the spy in Karthwasten to learn more.

I have gathered information from both of the Remnant spies that reside in Skyrim. It seems that the Thalmor will be transporting Rakeed to Morrowind very soon, crossing the border into Skyrim from the southwest and traveling the road near Sunderstone Gorge. I should return to Purewater Run and discuss the next step with Fijeh.

Fijeh has handed me a key to the Remnant supply chest. We plan to attack Ismal's caravan as soon as everyone is gathered at the attack location. Alternatively, I can approach the caravan and get the job done myself.
objectives: Obtain the Remnant equipment from the supply chest
Join the Remnant warriors to begin the assault|125|Approach the caravan alone

journal: I've begun my assault on Ismal's caravan in my attempt to free Rakeed.
I met the Remnant warriors near Ismal's caravan. We now need to find Rakeed and free him from the Thalmor.
Rakeed has been rescued from the Thalmor caravan. I should speak to Fijeh one last time now that the mission is complete.

Fijeh thanked me and paid me for my efforts. And with that, Fijeh cast an invisibility spell and disappeared along with Rakeed. I should investigate the Remnant supply chest that Fijeh gave me a key to unlock.

Fijeh thanked me and paid me for my efforts. And with that, Fijeh cast an invisibility spell and disappeared along with Rakeed. I searched the supply chest that Fijeh gave me a key to unlock, and discovered a set of Remnant weapons and armor.

Fijeh thanked me and paid me for my efforts. And with that, Fijeh cast an invisibility spell and disappeared along with Rakeed. I searched the supply chest that Fijeh gave me a key to unlock, and discovered a set of Remnant weapons and armor.

Morthal's Jarl has asked me to investigate the house fire that killed Hroggar's wife and child. Hroggar took Alva as a lover immediately after the fire, and many in the town think he did it.
Morthal's Jarl has asked me to investigate the death of Hroggar's wife and child. Hroggar took Alva as a lover immediately afterward. I suspect she may be a vampire, but I need proof for the Jarl.

description: Track down Kagrenac's missing Tools.

journal: Rumors say an old refugee trunk full of letters has been uncovered in Windhelm. I should see if I can find a copy of those letters and more information on the cargo they were carrying.
objectives: Find the caravan's letters in Windhelm

journal: I've found one of the letters, which details the routes of both the caravans as well as decoys designed to misdirect potential thieves. According to the letter, the first caravan was headed west toward Nightgate Inn. Perhaps following its trail will lead to another clue.

The first caravan was attacked by Dwarven creatures. They managed to escape but I found a copy of their logs, along with details of all the other caravans. The next carriage was headed towards Whiterun. I should see what I can find.

On the road to Whiterun I found the remnants of another sacked caravan. According to a note I found in the wreckage, the remaining caravans were set to regroup in Whiterun, and one of the guards visited the Halls of the Dead there.
objectives: Find evidence of the caravans in Whiterun

journal: In response to the attacks, the caravans took a detour towards Falkreath. I'll need to follow their trail to see if they left anything behind.

The cargo the caravans were delivering appears to hold the missing Tools of Kagremac: Sunder and Wraithguard. Apparently the items were surrendered to Dwemer drones and taken to a vault in the Sightless Pit. If I'm to open the door, I need to take this attunement crystal I found and use it to unlock the vault.
objectives: Enter the vault in the Sightless Pit

journal: I've unlocked the Sightless Vault. Within lies Sunder and Wraithguard.
As predicted, both Tools are guarded by a powerful Dwarven Centurion. I'll have to defeat it if I'm to claim them as my own.
I've defeated the Dwarven defenses and claimed both Sunder and Wraithguard for myself.

Captain Veleth explained that the ash spawn have been attacking Raven Rock for some time now, and he's been trying to locate their source. His lack of manpower and reluctance to leave the town without a commander are keeping him from finding out more. As a result of our conversation, I've agreed to help him deal with this situation. He's sent me to Fort Frostmoth to kill the author of the note, General Falx Carius, before the town falls prey to his threats.

It seems that Brutius was a wizard that has been luring unsuspecting fisherman into the woods under the guise of a fishing contest, only to slay and rob them. Of note is an enchanted ring that he recently lost in the river at the fishing spot he lured his victims. I might be able to claim it if I try fishing there myself.

Tamriel is a better place without Brutius preying upon the citizens of Morthal. I also managed to fish up the Warlock's Ring, the ring Bruitus lost at the spot near the river where he lured his victims.

journal: Adril Arano has requested my help with what he believes is an imminent threat on Councilor Morvayn's life. He believes members of the Ulen family are present on the island and seek revenge upon Morvayn for executing their ancestor. He's requested that I investigate the identity of any possible assassins, hoping to catch them unaware. Adril suggests that I start by speaking to Geldis Sadri, the innkeeper at the Retching Netch Cornerclub. He's hoping that Geldis, who has quite the reputation as a gossip, might have some useful leads.

Geldis Sadri has pointed out that someone is leaving ash yam offerings in the Ulen Ancestral Tomb even though no Ulens live on Solstheim. He suggests that I stake the tomb out at night and discover the identity of the mystery visitor. Hopefully this person is either the assassin himself or can lead me to the assassin threatening Councilor Morvayn's life.

journal: I discovered Tilisu Severin visiting the Ulen Ancestral Tomb at night. This seems suspicious, as she doesn't belong to the Ulen family by name. I should bring this piece of evidence to Adril Arano immediately.

I've informed Adril Arano that Tilisu Severin was the mystery vistor leaving offerings in the Ulen Ancestral Tomb. Since this is not enough evidence to accuse her of a crime, he's sending me to Severin Manor in order to uncover solid evidence that exposes Tilisu as an assassin.

I've recovered evidence from Severin Manor that exposes the true nature of the Severin family. The letters indicate that Vendil Severin is actually Vendil Ulen and that his supposed wife Tilisu and his daughter Mirri are members of House Hlaalu, one of the Great Houses that opposes Morvayn's House Redoran. All three of them are working in conjuction with unknown forces in a place called "Ashfallow Citadel," to assassinate Councilor Morvayn. I need to bring this urgent revelation to Adril Arano immediately.

name: The Cause (quest)
description: Investigate the activities of the Mythic Dawn cult.

journal: I found the Oblivion Gate and defeated the leader of the Mythic Dawn, Vonos. It appears this was an elaborate ritual designed to deceive me, and killing Vonos was the final step. I have become an unwitting instrument of Mehrunes Dagon, and my actions have opened the Oblivion Gate.
Centuries have passed since the Oblivion Crisis, yet remnants of that era may still exist in Skyrim. I should pay attention to any news or rumors.
A courier has delivered a letter from a stranger. It looks like a plea for help. I should read it and see what it says.

I received a letter from someone named Skorvild claiming to be a reformed member of the Mythic Dawn. He mentioned the Oblivion Crisis and asked me to meet him at the Shrine to Stendarr. I should go there and see what he has to say.
objectives: Meet Skorvild at the Shrine to Stendarr

journal: The stranger who sent me the letter, Skorvild, was apparently murdered by two Mythic Dawn assassins before I could meet with him. They ambushed me when I arrived, but I defeated them. I should look around to find any additional information.

A stranger asked for my help, but he was killed before I arrived. I was then ambushed by two assassins. I learned that the Mythic Dawn have reemerged, and that they've somehow reassembled an Oblivion gate, but need a powerful artifact to open it. A camp was mentioned in the notes I found. I should go there to see what I can find.
objectives: Search for clues in the Mythic Dawn camp

journal: The Mythic Dawn have repaired an Oblivion Gate, but need a Great Welkynd Stone to open it. To avoid the Vigilants of Stendarr they've excavated a back way into an ancient Ayleid ruin where such a stone is rumored to be hidden. A journal at their camp mentioned something about a secret chamber. I should investigate the ruin and see if I can find it before they do.
objectives: Search Rielle for clues about the secret chamber

journal: The Mythic Dawn have been searching an Ayleid ruin where a Great Welkynd Stone is rumored to be hidden within a secret chamber. They have been unable to find this chamber, but one of the explorers discovered Ayleid Elemental Shards may be the keys to opening it. I should find the shards.

The Mythic Dawn have been searching for a secret chamber within an Ayleid ruin that may contain a Great Welkynd Stone. I found four Ayleid Elemental Shards that may help me gain access to this chamber. I should return them to their holders.
objectives: Locate the Ayleid Elemental Shard Holders

journal: I placed the four Ayleid Elemental Shards in their holders, and a passage to a hidden chamber opened. I should investigate and see if I can locate the Great Welkynd Stone.
I gained access to the secret chamber within Rielle and retrieved the Great Welkynd Stone, but was ambushed by an Ayleid Lich. I need to defeat him in order to escape.

I found and retrieved the Great Welkynd Stone from within Rielle, and defeated the Ayleid Lich guardian, but the Mythic Dawn will stop at nothing to bring Mehrunes Dagon into power. I should search for any clues nearby that might lead me to the location of the Oblivion Gate.
objectives: Find clues to the Oblivion Gate's location

journal: While searching for clues about the Mythic Dawn's whereabouts I found a journal on a dead Vigilant of Stendarr. They learned of the Mythic Dawn's plot by capturing and interrogating a priest, and were able to decipher the location of the Oblivion Gate. I should go there and see if I can get inside. Wearing a set of Mythic Dawn robes might make it easier, but I need to be careful.
objectives: (Optional) Wear a set of Mythic Dawn robes

journal: I've found the repaired Oblivion Gate deep inside Red Scar Cavern, the Mythic Dawn hideout. The leader of the Mythic Dawn, Vonos, will stop at nothing to bring Mehrunes Dagon to power, and must be defeated.

Despite being specifically instructed by Malacath to see to it himself, Yamarz wants my help in defeating the giants that have overrun Fallowstone Cave and the shrine of Malacath. He's promised to pay me in exchange for making sure he arrives there safely.

journal: The curse placed on the Orcs of Largashbur is lifted. Malacath has named Gularzob as the new chief, and has named me his new Champion.

In order to free the people of the Skaal, and to thwart Miraak's plans, I have learned a new Word of Power. I must use this new knowledge to disrupt the activity at the Wind Stone, where the Skaal are working against their will.

description: Lay the spirits of Goldenhills Plantation to rest.

journal: In Skyrim, talking to an innkeeper can provide you with jobs, rumors, and other interesting leads. I should speak with one and find out if they have anything I can help with.

Goldenhills Plantation near Rorikstead is reportedly haunted by ghosts that harass travelers on the road. The Jarl of Whiterun Hold is offering the plantation itself as a reward for anyone who can lay the spirits to rest. I should head to Goldenhills Plantation to investigate.

Upon reaching Goldenhills Plantation, I discoverd that the rumors were true - this place is indeed haunted by the restless dead. What is driving the spirits of these simple farmers to such rage? And what sort of tragedy caused their untimely deaths? I should search the farm to find out more.

Urval accused his wife of being a witch before attacking her, after which she appears to have poisoned him. Could Jonquil have murdered her own son? I should try to find her secret laboratory to uncover the truth.
Jonquil believed her angry, controlling husband had killed their son, Rin, so she poisoned him. Could Urval have murdered his own son? I should search the farm to find out more.

I have uncovered the truth about what occurred at Goldenhills Plantation. After their son disappeared, Urval and Jonquil killed each other - Jonquil with extract of Deadly Nightshade, Urval with an axe - each thinking that the other had murdered their son, Rin. The only way to finally bring peace to their spirits is to discover what really became of Rin.
objectives: Find out what happened to Rin

journal: I have uncovered the horrible truth about what occured at Goldenhills plantation. After their son disappeared, Urval and Jonquil killed each other, and their son appears to have run away to escape his parents' bickering. The only way to finally bring peace to the spirits here is to find out what happened to Rin, and to do that I need to find the old well mentioned in his journal.

I have found Rin's remains near the old well, along with his beloved toy sword. According to his journal, he ran away from home to escape his parents' constant fighting; apparently, it looks like the wolves got the better of him. I should return the toy sword to Goldenhills Plantation, so that the spirits of Urval and Jonquil can finally know the truth of what happened to their son.
objectives: Return Rin's toy sword to the farm

journal: The restless spirits at Goldenhills Plantation can finally rest in peace, reunited with the spirit of their son and knowing that neither of them murdered their only child. Now that Goldenhills Plantation is no longer haunted, I can claim it for my own.

name: Tusked Terror
description: Slay Fangtusk.

journal: The Jarl of Windhelm has put out a bounty on a monsterous horker known as Fangtusk, which has been terrorizing fishermen north of Hollyfrost Farm. Fishermen have learned that it seems to enjoy arctic grayling above all other fish. I should obtain an arctic grayling and leave it near its feeding grounds in order to lure it out.
objectives: Place an arctic grayling at Fangtusk's feeding grounds

journal: I've placed an arctic grayling at Fangtusk's feeding grounds, which seems to have lured it out. I can now slay it in order to rid the area of its hostility.

I have slain Fangtusk. During the battle, I discovered that the rumors about its ability to drain the life of those around it are true. I should inspect it to learn what, if anything, has granted it this unnatural ability.
After slaying Fangtusk, I discovered the remains of a vampire inside its gut, along with an enchanted vampiric ring. I should show the Jarl's steward the ring as proof that the deed is done.
I showed the vampiric ring taken from Fangtusk to Jarl of Windhelm's steward, who rewarded me for fulfilling the bounty.

name: Two of a Kind
description: Every fish needs a friend!
reward: A set of rare alchemy Ingredients, 1-9 gold

journal: I received a letter from Mila Valentia. I should read what it has to say.
Mila Valentia in Whiterun wrote me a letter saying that the goldfish I brought her needs a companion. I should bring her another goldfish whenever the opportunity arises.
I brought Mila another goldfish. I should follow her to the trough where she will keep them.
Mila's goldfish now has a new companion. In exchange, she gave me a note and a key. I should see what the note has to say.

Mila's note mentions that she keeps "treasure" in a secret hiding place where she likes to play behind Dragonreach. It's likely just things she's found around Whiterun, but I should check just to be certain.

I brought Mila Valentia another goldfish. In exchange, she gave me the key to her treasure box at her hiding spot behind Dragonsreach. I was surprised to discover that she has collected a set of rare alchemy ingredients.

name: Unseen Visions
description: Perform a ceremony to read the Elder Scroll.

journal: After discovering that Dexion has become blind, I've had to secure alternate means to decipher the Elder Scrolls and locate Auriel's Bow. It's been suggested that I might be able to read the Elder Scrolls myself if I use an ancient technique performed by the original Moth Priests. I'm now on my way to a place known as the Ancestor Glade to discover the origin of the mysterious ritual.

objectives: Gather bark from a Canticle Tree

journal: I've used the unusual knife to collect the bark from the Canticle Trees dotting the Ancestor Glade, which has in turn drawn Ancestor Moths to me. I've felt a surge of energy run through my body and I feel drawn towards the large column of light in the center of the Glade.
objectives: Enter the column of light and read the Elder Scroll (Blood)

journal: I'm now standing in a column of light which appears to stretch into the sky at the center of the Ancestor Glade. According to Dexion, I've completed the Ritual of the Ancestor Moth and can now read the Elder Scrolls. I'll need to begin with the Elder Scroll I obtained from the Soul Cairn in order to decipher the location of Auriel's Bow.

After entering the column of light in the Ancestor Glade, I was able to read the Elder Scrolls. I had an incredible vision that pinpointed a cave entrance far away on the western edge of Skyrim. This appears to be the location of Auriel's Bow. If I'm to stop Harkon from completing the Tyranny of the Sun, I should hasten there immediately.

journal: I've heard rumors that a Nordic ruin, Champion's Rest, was recently uncovered in a silver mine near Shor's Stone. The miners reportedly fled, leaving their belongings behind. I should investigate the miner's campsite to see if I can learn anything about what caused them to flee.

The miners witnessed an armor-clad ghost wielding a menacing blade that struck fear into them, causing them to flee. A Vigilant of Stendarr investigated, and suspects that this blade may be Umbra, a Daedric artifact with the power to steal souls and bend its bearer to its will. I should investigate the ruins to find the source of this dark presence. As long as this threat remains, Shor's Stone is not safe.

I witnessed an armor-clad ghost that quickly disappeared while exploring Champion's Rest. The sighting filled me with a sense of dread. I should investigate the ruins to find the source of this dark presence.
objectives: Investigate the dark presence in Champion's Rest

journal: I've come to the great battle arena within Champion's Rest, and discovered an armored specter wielding Umbra. I will need to defeat the phantom in order to rid Shor's Stone of the danger posed by this powerful force.

I've come to the great battle arena within Champion's Rest, and discovered an armored specter. I will need to defeat the phantom in order to rid Shor's Stone of the danger posed by this powerful force.

The blade of the defeated spectral warrior awaits a new owner. When I gaze upon it, a single word is whispered in my mind: "Umbra". I should take it to prevent it from falling into the wrong hands again.
I was able to rid Shor's Stone of the danger posed by the artifact sword Umbra by defeating its former bearer and retrieving it for myself.

name: Waking Nightmare
description: Relieve the people of Dawnstar from Vaermina's curse.
reward: Skull of Corruption or Erandur as a Follower

journal: I've overheard two citizens of Dawnstar complaining about horrible nightmares. They seem to be relying on a priest of Mara named Erandur for assistance.

Erandur has assured me he can end the nightmares, the source of which seems to be within Nightcaller Temple, a place of worship for Vaermina. I have agreed to assist him in this endeavor and we are now on our way.

Erandur has revealed that Nightcaller Temple contains the legendary Skull of Corruption, an artifact of great power. In order to end the nightmares, we must breach the inner sanctum and allow Erandur to perform a ritual on the Skull which will render it inert.

From a tome obtained in the temple's library, Erandur has discovered a way to breach the inner sanctum. By obtaining a special liquid, we'll be able to perform a Dreamstride... travel a distance using another subject's dreams.

With Vaermina's Torpor in hand, I am ready to undergo the Dreamstride. I must drink the liquid which will enable me to enter the dreams of those who still slumber within these walls and use them to breach the inner sanctum.

I've found myself within the dreams of a priest of Vaermina. I am experiencing the Orc invasion of the temple over a decade ago. In the guise of the priest, I've been tasked with releasing the Miasma and placing everyone inside the temple in a deep sleep.
After awakening from the Dreamstride, I was able to remove the barrier to the inner sanctum. I must now follow Erandur to the Skull of Corruption so it can be rendered inert.
objectives: Follow Erandur to the Skull of Corruption
Wait for Erandur to dispel the barrier

journal: I've heard the words of the goddess Vaermina, who claims that Erandur will kill me after the ritual to destroy the Skull of Corruption is complete. I must make a choice; either allow Erandur to complete the ritual and destroy the Skull, or kill Erandur and wield the Skull of Corruption as my own.
objectives: Murder Erandur|180|Allow Erandur to complete his ritual

journal: I've made my decision, and allowed Erandur to live. The Skull of Corruption has been destroyed and Erandur has offered his services as a companion if I should ever need his assistance.
I've made my decision and Erandur has died by my hands. Unfortunately, the Skull of Corruption was destroyed before I could take his life. Such moments are the misfortunes of the indecisive.
I've made my decision and Erandur has died by my hands. I now possess the Skull of Corruption and look forward to performing my duties for Lady Vaermina.

name: Wave Breaker
description: Dawnstar is threatened by a giant crab!

journal: I received a hastily written letter from Viriya. I should read what it has to say.

Viriya received a letter from Jarl [Jarl] in Dawnstar. The frenzied mudcrabs have emerged once again. When the Dawnstar guard arrived, they were attacked by a spirit that caused them to flee in terror. Viriya is already on her way to Dawnstar and asked for my assistance. I should answer the call and return to the shore west of Dawnstar.
objectives: Return to the shore west of Dawnstar

journal: I have arrived once again at the shore west of Dawnstar. The signs of a recent battle scar the surrounding area where Viriya and a handful of guards have stood their ground against a mudcrab horde. As I approached, the frenzied mudcrabs began to emerge from the sea again. I should help Viriya and the guards defeat them.
I've helped Viriya and the guards defeat a wave of frenzied mudcrabs, but more are coming. I should take a moment to prepare for the next assault.
Another wave of frenzied mudcrabs have emerged from the sea west of Dawnstar, this time more numerous than ever. We will need to fend them off once more.
After several hard-fought battles, the frenzied mudcrab attacks have stopped for now. We should regroup inside the shack nearby.
objectives: Regroup with Viriya inside the shack

journal: Now that we've regrouped after the battle, I should speak to Viriya inside the shack.

The guardian spirit of a massive emperor crab has materialized off the coast, along with a new wave of mudcrabs. The guardian spirit is too large to be harmed by normal means. However, I should be able to use the catapults the guards have put in position nearby. The mudcrabs seem to have collected the flaming pots from the wrecked wagon near the shack. I will have to recover them from the mudcrabs and use them to fire the catapults at the guardian spirit.
objectives: Fire the catapults at the Emperor Crab Guardian Spirit (0/4)
Fire catapults at the Emperor Crab Guardian Spirit using flaming pots (0/4)
Obtain flaming pots from the frenzied mudcrabs

journal: Using the catapults, I managed to vanquish the emperor crab guardian spirit. The swarms of frenzied mudcrabs have come to an end. I should speak to Viriya now that the battle is over.

In the aftermath of the battle, Viriya thanked me for helping defeat the guardian spirit of the emperor crab. The guards must tend to their wounds, and Viriya will make the long journey back to Riften. The emperor crab guardian spirit and its horde of frenzied mudcrabs should no longer threaten the people of Dawnstar. I should travel to Dawnstar and inform the Jarl that the battle was a success.

journal: Astrid, of the Dark Brotherhood, informed me that by killing Grelod the Kind, I have robbed her organization of a kill. I have been taken captive and moved to some remote shack. Astrid will only give me the key if I kill someone she has taken captive, to "repay my debt."

I have killed one of the captives as Astrid instructed, and must now gain entrance to the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, which is located in the southern Pine Forest. Astrid has provided me with the correct passphrase - "Silence, my Brother."
I have killed an innocent person, gained entrance into the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and been officially welcomed into the Dark Brotherhood by Astrid. There's no turning back now.
Astrid invited me into the Dark Brotherhood, but I killed her instead. I will now never be able to join the shadowy organization of assassins.
